title: Image and container
prompt: Which statement matches the Docker model?
choices: An image is a template; a container is a running instance
A container is built once and an image is created every run
An image includes the host kernel
answer: An image is a template; a container is a running instance
explanation: Docker's documentation distinguishes an image, the packaged filesystem and configuration, from a container, a runnable instance of that image. Containers share the host kernel.
